googleMapsReviews.author: Maria E Martinez
googleMapsReviews.text:
Delicious & Worth the Visit!

Absolutely loved everything we tried! 😍 The crepes, S’mores frappe, pistachio-guava-and-cheese waffles, mimosas, and sangria were all delicious. The steak panini and the pear & chicken flatbreads were truly over the top!

And the gelato… 🍨 They have 30 different flavors, and honestly, their gelato and affogato’s was even better than some of the gelato I had in Italy! 🇮🇹❤️

Everything was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully done. Definitely a place I would come back to again and again. Highly recommend! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

googleMapsReviews.author: Venessa Lebron
googleMapsReviews.text:
Decided to try this place after seeing it on TikTok, everything was so delicious.
I ordered a latte, turkey avocado panini and my husband ordered a chicken panini.

For dessert I got the pistachio and coconut gelato and hubby got the cookies and cream gelato. I’ve been to Italy — let me tell you the gelato here is the exact same! So delicious will be coming back!

googleMapsReviews.author: Danielle Nakeia
googleMapsReviews.text:
407Cafe is such a cute spot if you’re looking for a little taste of Europe right here in Orlando! The café has a cozy atmosphere and a great mix of sweet and savory options.

I tried the Turkey Avocado Club Panini, the Piña Colada frozen drink, and their popular 407 Oreo Sweet Crêpe with Nutella drizzle. Everything was enjoyable, but the crêpe was definitely my favorite, it’s such a good choice if you have a sweet tooth! They also have a huge variety of gelato flavors, so there’s plenty to choose from.

I also love that they offer wine all day and that you can order through DoorDash and Uber Eats.

Definitely worth checking out if you’re in the Orlando area and want European café vibes with plenty of options!

googleMapsReviews.author: Engy Rofail
googleMapsReviews.text: We are from out of town but everytime we visit family here, we always come to CAFE 407! We have tried many items off the menu and everything is absolutely delicious! We love their paninis and affogatos the most. The ladies are so friendly and welcoming. Highly recommend

googleMapsReviews.author: Jennie Harrison
googleMapsReviews.text: OMG, what a hidden gem. I found it on TikTok and I love to try new places this place surpassed all my Once. I try to consider myself a coffee connoisseur when really I just like flavored coffee.!!! This place was phenomenal and Greisy Was phenomenal

doordashReviews.author: Rachel F
doordashReviews.text: Literally my sister worked here and it was the best thing ever I got to try the milkshakes crepes and the ice cream! And it was so good to!

doordashReviews.author: Arianni L
doordashReviews.text: Me encantó la frescura y lo delicioso del aderezo. Tes como una vinagreta con un toque dulce. Le da un sabor increíble a la ensalada x muy buen tamaño. Definitivamente lo volvería a ordenar

doordashReviews.author: Janelle M
doordashReviews.text: Kids loved the S'mores Nutella Waffle and I loved the steak inside the Avocado Crepe didn't really like the avocado if tasted store bought and not fresh so that was throwing me off. Portions was fair for the price. I would order again.

doordashReviews.author: Abby D
doordashReviews.text: The paninn is extremly good. The latte however was awful and it was $8 for a small cup. (Milk was $1something and flavor was $1something)

doordashReviews.author: Tanyia D
doordashReviews.text: The food is always fresh, yummy and delicious!My fave is the S'mores Nutella Waffle with strawberries added.10/10 My husband says the Smoked Salmon Limone is amazing!
